title: fix(spec): liveness ledger rows cite the seam modules that now hold the moved engine bodies
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao9NFKhq5MmwptNuMX9ewhqz)_

Fixes #25790
Part of #25677 (cutover prep I: `main` must read green before the cutover PR).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was red, measured on `main` 5612dd931b

`check-liveness.test.ts` fails 23 tests, but they are **23 tests with one cause, not 23 rows**. Every one of them runs the gate over a verbatim copy of the shipped ledgers and asserts exit 0; each fails `expected 1 to be +0` on the same single finding:

```
key-mention anchoring: 762 (entry, cited file) pair(s) asked, 760 anchored, 1 exempt, 1 UNANCHORED.
✗ translation/flows.screens → packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts
```

`engine.ts` no longer names `screens` at all. Its one mention was an unrelated comment ("states two screens down") inside `resumeInternal`'s body, which 0189524a41 moved to `run-resume.ts:1462`. So the row was anchored by accident before, and the move exposed a citation whose cited body had already left the file.

The 23 `engine.ts#` lines the card counts are 22 citation rows plus one historical `note`. All 22 still resolve and anchor except the `screens` row, but 7 of them cite a method whose body now lives in a seam module, so the code their prose quotes is no longer in the cited body. This PR re-points six of them; the seventh (row 21) keeps its citation for the reason in the table. The other 15 cite bodies still in `engine.ts` and are unchanged.

## The rows

`SA` = `packages/services/service-automation/src/`. Bodies located by reading each cited method at 5612dd931b (a wrapper says `The body lives in ./X.ts`).

| # | Ledger row | Old citation | New citation | Measured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1–5 | connector `name`, `label`, `type`, `description`, `icon` | `SA/engine.ts#getConnectorDescriptors` | unchanged | body still in `engine.ts` (`name: def.name` …) |
| 6 | connector `actions.children.key` | `SA/engine.ts#registerConnector` | `SA/plugin-extension-api.ts#registerConnector` | the quoted `if (typeof handlers[action.key] !== 'function')` throw is at `plugin-extension-api.ts:349`. Prose also named `getConnectorActionHandler`, which does not exist; the method is `resolveConnectorAction` (`engine.ts:3820`). `resolveConnectorActionEffect` / `getConnectorDescriptors` pointers unchanged (bodies in `engine.ts`) |
| 7–10 | connector `actions.children.label`, `description`, `inputSchema`, `outputSchema` | `SA/engine.ts#getConnectorDescriptors` | unchanged | body in `engine.ts` |
| 11 | connector `actions.children.effect` | `SA/engine.ts#resolveConnectorActionEffect`, `#getConnectorDescriptors` | unchanged | the quoted `find((a) => a.key === actionId)?.effect` is at `engine.ts:3838` |
| 12 | flow `successMessage` | `SA/engine.ts#executeWithoutRetry`, `SA/engine.ts#resumeInternal` | `SA/dag-traversal.ts#executeWithoutRetry`, `SA/run-resume.ts#resumeInternal` | quoted `successMessage: flow.successMessage` at `dag-traversal.ts:1278`; resumed run at `run-resume.ts:1552` |
| 13 | flow `errorMessage` | `SA/engine.ts#retryExecution`, `SA/engine.ts#resumeInternal` | `retryExecution` unchanged, `SA/run-resume.ts#resumeInternal` | `retryExecution`'s body is in `engine.ts` (`errorMessage: flowErrorMessage`); quoted `errorMessage: flow.errorMessage` at `run-resume.ts:1809` |
| 14 | flow `status` | `SA/engine.ts#registerFlow`, `#isFlowEnabled` | unchanged | both bodies in `engine.ts`; quote verbatim at `:4171` |
| 15 | flow `type` | `SA/engine.ts#resolveTriggerBinding` | `SA/plugin-extension-api.ts#deriveTriggerBinding`, `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-trigger-kind.ts#resolveFlowTriggerKind` | `resolveTriggerBinding` is a lookup that hands the flow to `deriveTriggerBinding`, whose body moved. The quoted `flow.type === 'schedule'` exists nowhere now; the read is `f.type === 'schedule'` / `f.type === 'api'` in the shared resolver. Prose rewritten to match |
| 16 | job `pull.children.mapping` | `SA/engine.ts#AutomationEngine` (`pullConnectorSource`) | unchanged | body in `engine.ts:4554` |
| 17–19 | translation `flows.label`, `flows.successMessage`, `flows.errorMessage` (`producer`) | `SA/engine.ts#AutomationEngine` | unchanged | `execute()` in `engine.ts` copies `flow.label` / `flow.successMessage` / `flow.errorMessage` (`:5786`, `:5782`, `:6054`); `producer` is not key-mention-scanned |
| 20 | translation `flows.screens` **(the red row)** | `SA/engine.ts#renderFlowTextSlot` | `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts#flowScreenCopyKey`; the renderer is named in the `screen-nodes.ts` clause, which calls it | the renderer's body (`node-text-rendering.ts#renderFlowTextSlot`) never names `screens` either (it reads `slot.key`), so citing it would stay red. The gate's own remedy is to cite the file that names the key: `flowScreenCopyKey` spells the address. Not exempted |
| 21 | translation `flows.refusals` | `SA/engine.ts#renderRefusalMessage` | citation unchanged; prose points at the drilled child | `node-text-rendering.ts` never names `refusals` (it is spelled by `flowRefusalMessageKey`), so re-pointing would red the row. `engine.ts` still names the key (`setI18nServiceSource` docblock, `:4527`) and the method is still the group's entry point |
| 22 | translation `flows.refusals.children.message` | `SA/engine.ts#translatedFlowTemplate`, `SA/engine.ts#renderRefusalMessage` | `SA/node-text-rendering.ts#translatedFlowTemplate`, `SA/node-text-rendering.ts#renderRefusalMessage` | both bodies moved; the file names `message` |
| note | connector retired `triggers` row, `note` | names `SA/engine.ts#registerConnector` | unchanged | a dated record of the retirement, not a citation; the gate does not read `note` |

7 rows edited (6, 12, 13, 15, 20, 21, 22), 0 rows deleted, no status changed. `undrilled-containers.baseline.json` and `key-mention.baseline.json` are untouched, and so are `engine.ts` and every seam module.

## Verification (head be47c5b1)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`: exit 1 before, exit 0 after. `evidence paths: 766 … 766 resolved` (was 762), `symbol anchors: 992 … 992 naming a symbol the cited file contains` (was 991), `key-mention anchoring: 766 … 765 anchored, 1 exempt` (was 760 anchored, 1 UNANCHORED).
- `vitest run scripts/liveness/` in `packages/spec`: before 23 failed / 48 passed in `check-liveness.test.ts`; after 12/12 files, 350/350 tests.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 65 families, all exit 0 on be47c5b1 after a full workspace build; `--ran` reconciles 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` patch, because `liveness` is in the package's `files` and ships.

## The 8/8 red on the same `main` run

Run 40187126172's `Test Core (8/8)` annotation is `plugin-pinyin-search … pnpm run test exited (1)`. The job log body could not be read from this container, so which test failed is NOT MEASURED. The package passes locally at this head, 4/4 files and 39/39 tests. That matches cutover bill item 26 (the `boot-reconcile.integration.test.ts` 5 s timing class); it is reported here, not fixed.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's mechanism assumption "23 rows ↔ 23 failures" does not hold: 23 tests fail on one row. The 22 citation rows were audited anyway, as the card asks.
- The card's `pnpm check:liveness` (root) is not a root script; the command is `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`.
- Not audited here: 17 `flow.json` rows cite bare `SA/engine.ts` with no symbol. They anchor at this head. Carrier: none.
